sources.title: Entropy-Aware Token Rejection for Improving Speculative Decoding
sources.snippet: Abstract Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens and a stronger target model to verify them. However, standard SD is mainly designed for acceleration, and its output quality is typically constrained by the target model.
